sources.name: Bitstamp PRO fee schedule (unified schedule effective 2026-09-01)
Kraken Pro fee schedule (unified 17-tier schedule effective 2026-07-09)
KuCoin VIP Fee Structure (official support article, updated 2026-05-07)
Note
sources.note: This feed starts at the 2026-09 ladder-snapshot baseline; complete pre-2026-09 history is not reconstructable from primary sources, so only changes evidenced by official venue pages already cited in fee_rates.json are seeded. Numeric before/after values are recorded only when stated in the official source. Records produced by the monthly snapshot diff carry confidence='detected' and are not curated.

changes.summary_en: Bitstamp moved to a unified PRO fee schedule (11 spot rungs, 0.30%/0.40% to 0.00%/0.03% at $1B 30-day volume); perpetuals remain a separate flat maker -0.005% rebate / 0.015% taker schedule for EEA-eligible users.
changes.summary_zh: Bitstamp 启用统一 PRO 费率表（现货 11 档，0.30%/0.40% 至 10 亿美元 30 日成交量的 0.00%/0.03%）；永续仍为独立的 maker -0.005% 返佣 / taker 0.015% 固定费率，仅限 EEA 合格用户。

changes.summary_en: OKX unified its spot and futures fee schedule (Regular spot 0.08%/0.10%, Regular futures 0.02%/0.05%), with the same nine-rung volume/assets OR-qualification structure on both product lines.
changes.summary_zh: OKX 启用统一的现货与合约费率表（普通用户现货 0.08%/0.10%、合约 0.02%/0.05%），两条产品线采用相同的九级“成交量或资产”OR 资格结构。

changes.summary_en: Kraken Pro moved to a unified 17-tier fee schedule spanning spot and futures, with triple-track qualification (30d spot volume / 30d futures volume / assets on platform); negative futures maker rates from Tier 11 are rebates.
changes.summary_zh: Kraken Pro 启用横跨现货与合约的统一 17 级费率表，采用三轨资格制（30 日现货成交量 / 30 日合约成交量 / 平台资产）；第 11 级起的负合约 maker 费率为返佣。

changes.summary_en: BingX inserted an Elite rung between Regular and VIP1 on futures: 0.018% maker / 0.045% taker from $5M 30-day volume.
changes.summary_zh: BingX 在合约普通档与 VIP1 之间插入 Elite 档：30 日成交量 500 万美元起，maker 0.018% / taker 0.045%。

changes.summary_en: BingX inserted an Elite rung between Regular and VIP1 on spot: 0.05% maker / 0.08% taker from $0.5M 30-day volume.
changes.summary_zh: BingX 在现货普通档与 VIP1 之间插入 Elite 档：30 日成交量 50 万美元起，maker 0.05% / taker 0.08%。

changes.summary_en: KuCoin's official VIP Fee Structure article was updated (Class A spot ladder quoted; Class B = 2x and Class C = 3x; thresholds use per-product 30d volume OR KCS holdings). The update date is the article's; exact numeric deltas were not separately announced.
changes.summary_zh: KuCoin 官方 VIP 费率结构文章更新（现货按 A 类交易对报价，B 类 2 倍、C 类 3 倍；门槛采用分产品 30 日成交量或 KCS 持仓）。具体数值变动未另行公告。
changes.note: Date is the official support article's last-updated date, not a separately announced effective date.

changes.summary_en: Bitget VIP system upgrade took effect, restructuring the spot and futures ladders (Regular spot 0.10%/0.10%, futures 0.02%/0.06%; volume/assets OR qualification).
changes.summary_zh: Bitget VIP 体系升级生效，重构现货与合约阶梯（普通档现货 0.10%/0.10%、合约 0.02%/0.06%；成交量或资产 OR 资格）。
